caption: The video captures a partly cloudy sky viewed looking upward, where the sun stays concealed behind a dark overhead cloud mass and throws crepuscular rays that fan downward through a deep blue expanse. Scattered white cumulus clouds, their sunward edges brightly lit, sit at the left, lower right, and along the bottom edge. Throughout, the clouds drift slowly, so the dark mass and the brighter cumulus forms shift position relative to the edges of the view. The sunlit opening behind the clouds moves and changes shape as cover passes in front, and the sunbeams alter in angle, spread, and intensity from one view to the next. Patches of open blue sky widen and narrow as the clouds translate, and the dark silhouette's top edge deforms, revealing small gaps of brightness. The drift is already underway at the start of the view and continues past its end without a clear beginning or resolution.
